title: Ministry of Attorney General (1 of 2)
focus: Tribunal independence and administrative support
review: Do not treat every body in the Attorney General portfolio as an organizational subdivision. For tribunals, distinguish statutory creation, commencement, appointment of members and first hearings. Shared registry or secretariat support does not merge legal identities. For Sheriff Services, Court Services, Legal Services and Family Justice, use historical branch rosters as well as modern service descriptions. The queue's ministry-lineage table is a search lead, not a dated parent history. The Ferry Commission particularly needs a distinction between independent status and portfolio responsibility.
sources_to_seek: Acts and commencement instruments; tribunal annual reports; dated Attorney General organization charts; pre-2002 branch rosters.

title: Ministry of Attorney General (2 of 2)
focus: Reconciliation, continuation and retrospective dates
review: The EAB manual's explicit 1982 account was rechecked; the home page's parenthesized 1981 is attached to an Act title. Retain the inherited selected 1981 claim pending its original basis, rather than choosing a winner. The Skilled Trades appeal-board continuity already described in the queue is not a new discovery here. CRT has competing jurisdiction-expansion dates and milestone repetitions; audit by claim, not by date/text deduplication. Prosecution's 1974 scalar date remains unresearched. Hospital Appeal Board and Energy Resource Appeal Tribunal history statements need source-publication and historical-effective dates separated.
sources_to_seek: Original selected-date claims; point-in-time legislation and commencement; annual reports; archived organization descriptions.

title: Ministry of Finance
focus: Finance: nested units, identity and placement
review: The current Comptroller General page was read: its stated reporting relationship is to the Deputy Minister of Finance, and its Internal audits section names Internal Audit & Advisory Services. This is more specific than attaching every Finance object directly to one ministry, but it is not a complete organization chart or an historical span. CABRO and Crown Agencies Secretariat must retain distinct IDs until an identity/continuity relationship is evidenced. Provincial Treasury and Government Chief Risk Office need identity bridges for earlier headings. Earlier Finance checkpoint work exists in the prior review; it is not rerun or claimed as new in this package.
sources_to_seek: Dated Finance organization charts; earlier service plans; original Finance checkpoint ledger; formation/transfer instruments.

title: Ministry of Citizens’ Services
focus: Institutions, brands and government service channels
review: The King's Printer FAQ was read and gives an 1859 institutional origin. Preserve that as colonial/institutional testimony, not the start of the modern name or a post-1871 ministry relationship. For Service BC, BC Stats and BC Bid, trace earlier names and delivery units before the oldest checkpoint. A procurement website, services card, registry platform and administrative office need not share a founding date. Do not merge BC OnLine with BC Registries merely because they deliver related services.
sources_to_seek: Historical printer reports; Queen’s Printer/King’s Printer name observations; procurement launch material; Citizens’ Services and predecessor organization charts.

title: Ministry of Education and Child Care
focus: Teachers Act transition and early-learning programme phases
review: This batch has the strongest new statutory checkpoint. The Teachers Act commencement instrument supports 9 January 2012 for the relevant framework; section 9 establishes the Teachers’ Council and section 26 the disciplinary board. Keep the commissioner's statutory framework separate from first appointment. The College of Teachers dissolution, director of certification and special account are discovery candidates outside this snapshot, subject to full-atlas deduplication. StrongStart's 14 December 2006 announcement is a programme-launch milestone, not proof that all centres opened that day. Earlier child-care delivery can predate its current Education placement.
sources_to_seek: Teachers Act and commencement instrument already recorded; appointments and initial annual reports next; early-learning launch and delivery documents; earlier child-care ministry rosters.

title: Ministry of Health
focus: Health schemes, offices and governing bodies
review: Distinguish MSP and PharmaCare as schemes/programmes from the Medical Services Commission and statutory offices. Legislative creation, commencement and actual appointment can differ for a health office. The regulatory oversight office has a 2024 scalar start but remains not_researched and C-only: recover its original date claim before treating start research as complete. Portals and registries need their own product/rollout histories rather than inheriting the history of the ministry or underlying service.
sources_to_seek: Health statutes and commencement orders; office appointment instruments; programme manuals and launch releases; ministry and board annual reports.

title: Ministry of Public Safety and Solicitor General
focus: Moved safety functions and incompatible date meanings
review: BC Corrections has inherited 1950 and 1951 descriptions; neither source was newly verified in this session, so retain a reconciliation task. The Fire Commissioner needs historical searches outside today's Public Safety portfolio. For the gambling-regulation transition, independently check commencement, transferred functions and cessation; this package does not newly verify the queue’s stated 2026 date. Coroners, RoadSafetyBC and policing/security functions require separate office, name and service histories.
sources_to_seek: Original Corrections history/archival claims; transfer and commencement orders; safety-portfolio rosters; regulator annual reports.

title: Ministry of Children and Family Development
focus: Service categories versus identifiable units
review: All eight entries require care about what is being dated: a service category, an actual administrative unit, a facility or a public contact channel. A child-protection telephone service is not automatically identical to a centralized screening organization. Maples needs facility and operating-unit milestones; it cannot stand in for all youth mental-health services. Adoption, foster care, support-needs services and youth justice may have policy histories much older than present-day names or delivery structures.
sources_to_seek: Contemporary MCFD and predecessor rosters; facility histories; programme manuals; specific unit-creation and service-launch material.

title: Ministry of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills
focus: Regulation, designations and platforms
review: Education Quality Assurance may describe a designation rather than an office. EducationPlannerBC requires a distinction between the service platform and its operating organization. For private training, trace earlier regulators and legal transfers instead of assigning the modern branch a predecessor’s start. StudentAid BC, the Provincial Nominee Program and newcomer services need programme and administrative histories recorded separately; ministry responsibility can change independently of the programme name.
sources_to_seek: Training/regulatory statutes and transfer instruments; operating-organization reports; immigration/student-aid programme launch and policy records.

title: Ministry of Water, Land and Resource Stewardship
focus: Resource services across changing ministries
review: Modern Water ministry lineage is not a reliable boundary for historical searching. River Forecast Centre and FrontCounter BC need source-dated placement under the ministries in existence then. Portals and permitting interfaces should remain service products unless a source identifies a corresponding unit. The inspected 2010 Environment page describes water licensing as a function only; no identity match or start was accepted for Water Licensing and Rights.
sources_to_seek: Contemporary resource-ministry service plans and organization charts; portal launch records; dated centre descriptions; whole-government rosters where placement is unknown.

title: Provincial Health Services Authority
focus: Health agencies, hospitals and actual programme transfers
review: PHSA formation does not date the birth of every hospital, agency or network beneath it. BC Cancer contains treatment-centre, corporate, legal-name and branding layers. BC Children's combines facility identities that need separate historical treatment. BC Renal's continuing parent row lacks an observation date. For Trans Care BC, a 2014 release planned an April 2015 transfer while PHSA retrospectively describes taking responsibility in fall 2015; preserve planned versus reported-actual milestones. PLMS remains unresearched despite a selected 2019 start.
sources_to_seek: Agency and hospital annual reports; society/corporate amalgamation records; PHSA transfer decisions; programme launch and service-change evidence.

title: Ministry of Energy and Climate Solutions
focus: Climate placement and unlike policy objects
review: The 2010 Estimates were visually checked: Climate Action Secretariat is a named sub-vote under Environment. This rechecks an earlier finding and demonstrates that current Energy ministry lineage is unsafe as the sole search route. It is a budget observation, not a founding date or an organizational-parent edge. CleanBC, funds, a council, a fuel standard and a pricing system are different object types. Their legal commencement, policy announcement and operating dates must not all be called agency establishment.
sources_to_seek: Environment and energy Estimates/service plans by actual document date; programme launch material; fund/account statutes; council establishment and appointments.

title: Ministry of Social Development and Poverty Reduction
focus: Assistance programmes and independent appeals
review: WorkBC's 2007 strategy/website and 2012 service-centre milestones have different subjects. Preserve components rather than selecting a single date for all of WorkBC. My Self Serve and the bus-pass programme need service-level histories. The appeal tribunal, accessibility directorate and accessibility committee require different relationships to the minister; legislation, committee appointment and service delivery are not interchangeable.
sources_to_seek: Programme manuals and launch material; employment-service procurement/transition records; tribunal statutes; accessibility regulations and appointment notices.

title: Ministry of Tourism, Arts, Culture and Sport
focus: Special accounts, branches and campaigns
review: Arts endowment and sports-fund records may be statutory accounts rather than organizational departments. Heritage and Mountain Resorts need historical branch rosters and transfer instruments. Community Gaming Grants should not inherit the regulatory body's history merely because both concern gaming. Let’s Go BC requires campaign/programme semantics. The athletic commissioner's framework, appointment and operational start should be separate milestones.
sources_to_seek: Special-account legislation and financial statements; branch organization charts; programme/campaign launch records; appointment instruments.

title: Ministry of Agriculture and Food
focus: Agriculture programme phases and predecessor boards
review: Insurance and income protection can be schemes with multiple legal/policy milestones. Buy BC needs evidence for programme phases, pauses and relaunches rather than assumed uninterrupted continuity. Distinguish the Animal Health Centre facility from the ministry's broader animal-health function. The liquor/cannabis regulator's modern name should not date its entire regulatory history. For BCFIRB, verify the predecessor boards and combined body separately.
sources_to_seek: Agricultural programme legislation/manuals; programme launch/relaunch records; tribunal annual reports; regulator transfer and renaming instruments.

title: Ministry of Emergency Management and Climate Readiness and Ministry of Housing and Municipal Affairs
focus: Emergency management and housing: programmes are not ministries
review: The establishment of a newer ministry does not automatically establish or terminate an emergency-management unit. PreparedBC, EmergencyInfoBC and ClimateReadyBC are branded services/portals requiring rollout histories. Disaster assistance/support services have different programme roots. Housing targets, short-term rental administration and building standards need statutory and administrative milestones; public libraries and University Endowment Lands require much earlier historical placements.
sources_to_seek: Ministry reorganization and transfer orders; emergency-programme records; housing commencement instruments; historical municipal/library rosters.

title: Ministry of Environment and Parks
focus: Parks, conservation functions and special accounts
review: Two missing BC Parks locators were recovered from the official history: the 1911 Strathcona legislation and 1957 separate Parks Branch. They are different milestones, not competing birthdays of one present-day body. The Conservation Officer Service's inherited 1909–14 range is truncated in the export and needs its full bounds recovered. EAO's two-source event needs source-specific locators. Sustainable Environment Fund Special Account was named in the inspected 2010 Environment scope; retain account semantics.
sources_to_seek: Original parks/conservation historical claims and tables; EAO legal/operational records; special-account legislation and Estimates.

title: Transportation Investment Corporation and Ministry of Indigenous Relations and Reconciliation
focus: Capital projects and Indigenous-relations structures
review: The six transportation projects are not six companies. Announcement, procurement, delivery responsibility, construction and opening must be independently dated. A transfer of project delivery is not a corporate succession. For Indigenous-relations divisions, use dated organization charts. First Citizens Fund, an advisory council and the Declaration Act Secretariat require account, advisory and organizational relationships respectively, rather than one generic parent relation.
sources_to_seek: Project milestone and delivery-agency documents; dated Indigenous-relations organization charts; fund authority; council and secretariat creation instruments.

title: Ministry of Mining and Critical Minerals and Columbia Power Corporation
focus: Mining offices, portals and power-company ownership
review: The Geological Survey requires a historical bureau/branch identity chain, while Mineral Titles Online is a platform. Critical-minerals and development offices need explicit formation sources. Mines health/safety may represent a function or organizational unit depending on the period. For the four Columbia Power records, distinguish legal companies from similarly named dams/assets and establish ownership percentages from contemporary financial-statement notes, not current grouped placement.
sources_to_seek: Geological survey reports; office-formation notices; portal launch records; consolidated financial statements and subsidiary/joint-venture notes.

title: Ministry of Forests and 2 more
focus: Forestry date conflicts and housing/business programmes
review: BC Timber Sales has a selected June 2003 start, an earlier May 2003 name observation and an April 2003 succession milestone. Recover each claim's meaning instead of choosing the minimum date. Wildfire's 2015 range has only one endpoint/source in its range row; preserve both observations and do not infer an exact rename. The Chief Forester is an office distinct from the whole forestry function. Business portals and housing brands/components should not become corporate subsidiaries merely through their current parent field.
sources_to_seek: Original Timber Sales and Wildfire claims; dated organization charts and annual reports; forestry statutory offices; programme/product launch evidence.

title: Forestry Innovation Investment Ltd. and 2 more
focus: Legal subsidiaries and labour offices
review: For FII in China, India and Vietnam, distinguish legal incorporation, market-office opening and trading brand. Infrastructure and real-property units may predate the current ministry; trace units rather than ministry lineage alone. Workers' and employers' advisers need evidence for statutory independence/support and actual organizational location. Labour tribunals and branches require statutory continuation, operating milestones and dated administrative support relationships.
sources_to_seek: FII consolidated financial-statement notes; dated property/capital organization charts; labour statutes, annual reports and office histories.

title: Ministry of Transportation and Transit and 3 more
focus: Corporate milestones, current ownership and venues
review: BC Hydro's current subsidiaries page supports observed ownership for Powerex, Powertech and Columbia Hydro Constructors, not the historical start of ownership. The CHC section reports formation in 1962; Powerex reports operations since 1988; a 2009 BC Hydro release reports Powertech serving customers since 1989. Keep those meanings separate from incorporation. The container-trucking commissioner has a 2014 scalar date without its original claim. BC Place and the convention centre need venue-opening, ownership and operating-entity milestones; PlayNow is not automatically a corporation.
sources_to_seek: Original incorporation claims and corporate filings; annual-report ownership notes; transport office creation orders; venue and platform launch/operating records.

title: Liquor Distribution Branch and 5 more
focus: Retail brands, archives, venues and investment holdings
review: BCLIQUOR and BC Cannabis Stores require retail-brand and rollout histories distinct from LDB's corporate/administrative history. BC Archives' institutional origin is not necessarily its Museum placement date; IMAX is a venue/operation. BCR Properties, Renaissance and QuadReal require legal identity and ownership-chain evidence rather than brand or asset age. The broadband company's 2011 scalar start remains unresearched and needs the original claim restored.
sources_to_seek: Retail launch/branding records; archives annual reports and governance instruments; corporate filings and financial-statement ownership notes; venue operating records.
